epics.title: Restore Orchestrator Source Checkout Reliability
epics.jtbd: When a developer or orchestrator evaluates the product, I want the source repository to be cloned successfully without timing out, so that the environment can be built and evaluated.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce git clone timeout error rate from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The git clone operation must complete successfully and the source code must be available for the build process without timing out.

slices.title: Resolve Git Clone Timeout
slices.jtbd: When implementing the checkout fix for this epic, I want to patch the clone timeout issue, so that the code is reliably fetched for deployment.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a git clone operation in the deployment environment
When the clone command is executed
Then it must fetch the source successfully without timing out
Given a successfully cloned repository
When the test suite verifies the checkout
Then the required files must be present and readable.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase git clone success rate to 100%
